title: Civics, Economics & Commerce
tagline: A humanities-led commerce stream pairing civics with economics, suited to law, civil services and management careers.
overview: CEC is an intermediate stream under the Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh, for students drawn to law, public policy, civil services and commerce. In place of mathematics it builds reading, reasoning and writing strength alongside a grounding in economics and commerce, the foundation that CLAT, CUET and undergraduate law and social science programmes look for.
highlights: Integrated CLAT and law entrance coaching
Current affairs and general awareness sessions
